title: KaLOS finds Consensus: A Meta-Algorithm for Evaluating Inter-Annotator Agreement in Complex Vision Tasks
mechanism: Meta-algorithm for inter-annotator agreement in vision tasks with instance correspondence, validated without circular reliance on a ground truth; argues benchmark progress is limited by label noise.
adaptation: Benchmark only: compute a KaLOS-style agreement on the doubly annotated EL cells (crack IoU 0.21-0.26 strict, 0.82-0.99 within 2 px) and report it as the label-noise ceiling next to model scores.
min_experiment: No training. Compute agreement per class and source on doubly annotated cells; decide whether a model gap smaller than the agreement spread is reported as a tie. Kill: not applicable (reporting tool).
evidence: R: proposes and validates an agreement meta-algorithm for detection and instance segmentation (abstract only).
prior_overlap: none. Annotator agreement was measured as IoU only.
